format_observations.byte_stream: records in source table order; each record contributes element_size * element_count bytes from its pointed-to address
format_observations.header_array: g_2776[128] exists with a source comment describing a MacBinary-style header, but SaveGame/LoadGame bodies do not reference it
format_observations.trailing_bytes: LoadGame reads the expected record stream only and does not test EOF after the final record
format_observations.failure_atomicity: LoadGame resets yard before reading, then writes directly into live pointed-to data; a short read sets fd_50F6_0EAC=-1 and leaves reset/partially loaded state without rollback
format_observations.save_write_check: SaveGame treats only write==-1 as failure; positive short writes are not detected
format_observations.overwrite_behavior: existing file is opened O_RDWR without truncation; replacement writes begin at current offset 0 and may leave any old tail beyond payload length
format_observations.dirty_word: SaveGame clears fd_3D57_02C2 after record writes and before close/confirmation notice; LoadGame clears it after file selection and before open/read
